source.citation: Owner-supplied likeness model for Alice M. Stirling, supplied 26 November 2026 with instructions to match and apply the face in 1904, and to store a period portrait without modern clothing or background.
what_it_does_not_supply: The historical person’s actual appearance, ancestry, measurements or photographic profile.
what_it_supplies: Owner-chosen reconstructed facial likeness and colouring.
